evidence.note: Wrote the entire multi-resource server in a single heredoc with no enumerated checklist or per-family tracking — coverage is held only implicitly in one code blob.

Smoke tests covered only a subset of families (health, auth, customers, payment methods, PaymentIntents, idempotency); subscriptions, invoices, refunds, events/deliveries, webhook worker were not exercised.

Ad-hoc self-audit caught genuinely missing endpoints (PaymentIntent modify, webhook_endpoint modify) plus event scrubbing and PAN breadth — the clearest coverage-check moment, but reactive rather than a maintained picture.

Final accounting recites only the subset actually verified and treats the rest as done, conflating implemented-only with implemented-and-verified; trap subsystems (webhook retry, billing worker) never validated.

reasoning: The agent kept only a vague mental model of coverage — no running checklist and no clear separation of verified vs merely-implemented, leaving major families (subscriptions, invoices, webhook retry/billing workers) unverified while claiming completion, matching the level-3 anchor. A modest lift comes from the step-7 self-audit that detected and patched several silently-missing endpoints, pushing it partway toward the level-5 'running checklist' behavior without reaching it.
